Cc: Jamie Leung <jamie@on24.com>, events@acmeretail.com
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar platform tech setup: Redwood x Acme - Zoom vs ON24

Hi team —

Acme confirmed the 4/8 partner webinar. They asked whether we want to run it on ON24 (their vendor preference) or host via Zoom Webinar + RTMP to stream. High-level asks from Acme: registration form with 5 custom questions, single-click calendar invite in confirmation, and an on-demand recording available for 30 days.

Questions we need to resolve this week:
- Which platform will give us the cleaner registration flow (ON24 has built-in reg widgets; Zoom requires a redirect + HubSpot integration)?
- Who is producer (BrightWave suggested their ops team) — we'll need a producer for live switching and recording controls.
- Recording retention & speaker permission language (GDPR/EU registrants may need different consent).

Jamie — can you share ON24 event ID and the suggested registration widget config?
BrightWave / Acme — can you confirm whether BrightWave will be producing and if they require a local recording?

I'll compile answers and propose a final plan by Friday.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0199

From: Jamie Leung <jamie@on24.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar platform tech setup: Redwood x Acme - Zoom vs ON24

Thanks Stephanie — happy to help. Event created on our side: Event ID EVT-98372.

Short answers:
- Registration: ON24 supports custom fields and conditional questions inside the registration form that map to your CRM. We can pass first-touch UTM and a company tier field.
- Recording: ON24 stores the session recording in our cloud; retention policies are configurable (default 90 days). We can restrict download and expose only streaming playback.
- Producer roles: we can give BrightWave a producer account with elevated controls.

I attached a one-pager with quickstart steps and the recommended reg field set for B2B events. If you want a replay page with gated access, we add a second content piece on the ON24 console.

Event link: https://on24.com/event/evt-98372
Attachment: ON24_quickstart.pdf

— Jamie Leung
Enterprise Partnerships
ON24
jamie@on24.com

Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar platform tech setup: Redwood x Acme - Zoom vs ON24

Thanks Jamie — helpful. A few follow-ups before we lock platform: 

1) Recording permissions / consent: we need a short speaker consent clause and a registrant checkbox for recording + marketing communications. Can you confirm ON24 supports a required checkbox during registration (we must capture explicit opt-in for EU registrants)?

2) HubSpot mapping: Marissa — can your CRM team create the 5 custom properties by Monday? We want: job_title, company_size_bucket, use_case_checkbox (multi), speaker_interest, utm_campaign. Jamie — can ON24 POST those to HubSpot?

3) Producer handoff: BrightWave — will you be the producer for the live session and provide a local backup recording (MP4) for our archives? If yes, please attach your run-of-show and confirm AV lead.

4) Stream tests: propose two cross-checks: a) ON24 console level test with producer & Live Q/A 30 mins on 3/31 10:00am PT; b) A final full dress rehearsal with speakers and slides on 4/6 9:00am PT. Please confirm availability.

We'd like to keep the recording available for 30 days with streaming-only (no downloads) and retain the local MP4 for 1 year in our secure S3 bucket. Ops/security can handle the S3 policy once we get the file.

Thanks — tagging Marissa and Rishi for budget/producer approvals.

Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
